title: Lagos
summary: Lagos Island was settled by Yoruba fishermen and hunters by the late 15th century, and Portuguese first landed there in 1472. Dominated by the kingdom of Benin, which called it Eko, it kept a slave trade until British control in 1861, when Oba Dosunmu was forced to sign a treaty of cession. Lagos was Nigeria's federal capital until December 1991 and remains its largest city.
